name: Galio Sundae Patisserie
summary: A single bakery dressed as a sorbet parlour: white pages on lemon, strawberry, mint and sky bands, cherry for every action, Shrikhand over Outfit with Caveat script kickers; a cocoa side rail with a scalloped awning edge (a top bar and menu sheet on phones), a hero slider of the best-selling collections, line-drawn collections, a mosaic of the real ways to get an order, a price list with dot leaders, best sellers on round tinted plates with tilted stickers, the real counter on a map and the journal. Light by default, with a dark mode and a footer Theme row.
